from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,math,sys
root=Path(sys.argv[1])

def summarize(samples):
 if not samples:return {'count':0}
 s=sorted(samples);n=len(s)
 return {'count':n,'min_nanos':s[0],'p50_nanos':s[(n*50+99)//100-1],'p95_nanos':s[(n*95+99)//100-1],'p99_nanos':s[(n*99+99)//100-1],'max_nanos':s[-1]}

results=[]
for directory in ['.']:
 summary=json.loads((root/directory/'manifest.json').read_text())
 assert len(summary['runs'])==6
 count=recovered=0
 for run in summary['runs']:
  path=root/directory/f"pair-{run['pair']}-{run['engine']}.stdout"
  assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==run['stdout_sha256']
  report=json.loads(path.read_text().removeprefix('concurrent_snapshot_reads '))
  assert not report['smoke'] and report['durability']=='SyncOnEveryWrite' and len(report['cases'])==13
  for case in report['cases']:
   reads=[];writes=[];read_intervals=[];writer=None
   assert len(case['workers'])==case['readers']+case['writers']
   for worker in case['workers']:
    assert worker['finished_nanos']>=worker['started_nanos']
    previous=worker['started_nanos']
    for request in worker['requests']:
     start=request['started_nanos'];end=start+request['elapsed_nanos']
     assert start>=previous and end<=worker['finished_nanos']
     previous=end
     (reads if worker['kind']=='read' else writes).append(request['elapsed_nanos'])
     if worker['kind']=='read':read_intervals.append((start,end))
    assert worker['latency']==summarize([r['elapsed_nanos'] for r in worker['requests']])
    if worker['kind']=='write':
     assert writer is None;writer=worker
   assert len(reads)==case['readers']*(512 if case['read_shape']=='point' else 256)
   assert len(writes)==case['writers']*512
   assert case['read_latency']==summarize(reads) and case['write_latency']==summarize(writes)
   elapsed=max(w['finished_nanos'] for w in case['workers'])-min(w['started_nanos'] for w in case['workers'])
   assert case['elapsed_nanos']==elapsed
   assert math.isclose(case['requests_per_second'],(len(reads)+len(writes))*1e9/elapsed,rel_tol=1e-12)
   overlap=0 if writer is None else sum(start>=writer['started_nanos'] and end<=writer['finished_nanos'] for start,end in read_intervals)
   assert case['read_requests_within_writer_phase']==overlap
   assert case['recovered_rows_verified']==16384+len(writes)
   assert case['recovered_commit_epoch']==131+len(writes)
   count+=len(reads)+len(writes);recovered+=case['recovered_rows_verified']
  assert run['report']['cases']==[{k:v for k,v in c.items() if k!='workers'} for c in report['cases']]
 assert count==141312 and recovered==1299456
 results.append({'directory':directory,'processes':6,'cases':78,'requests':count,'recovered_rows':recovered,'quantiles_worker_intervals_overlap_throughput_counts':'pass'})
(root/'independent-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
